# Why can't the G1 directly enter balance or walk mode when suspended in the gantry and feet are off the ground?

> **Current answer:** The balance strategy will still search for recovery actions under the assumption of grounded support, and may drive leg movement if the feet are not in contact with the ground. The gantry should remain in place for fall prevention, but the feet must actually touch the ground and have appropriate slack before entering the balance/walk policy.

## Environment

- Unitree G1 EDU; onboard Jetson development computing unit; SDK2 expects Ubuntu 20.04, GCC 9.4, CMake 3.10+.

## Priority diagnostics

- Check status, alerts, temperature, network, and calibration in the Explore App.
- SSH post to check interfaces and SDK2 example, read status before writing control.

## Possible causes

- The support/contact assumption in the balance strategy is invalid.
- Continuous motion leads to localized motor thermal accumulation.
- The Jetson image and robot internal software stack are out of sync.
- Network or DDS configuration errors.

## Attempts

- Maintain the gantry but ensure feet are grounded before activating balance.
- Stop the task, fix the gantry, return to idle, and cool down externally before investigating the root cause.
- Keep the vendor image, install the SDK as per official documentation.
- Compile and run a read-only state example.
